_comment: Documented divergences of the TS on-the-wire Redis surface against the redis_interop corpus (live Redis, per-case prefix, byte equality per index.json comparison.redis_interop). Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). Each entry names the TS source responsible.

cases.redis_interop/rio_rate_limit_endpoint_ti: endpoint-tier rate-limit keys use the raw request path (rate-limit.ts checkRateLimit key construction), not the reference sha256 path digest
cases.redis_interop/rio_ban_cidr_network: no CIDR network ban write seam: IPBanManager (ip-ban.ts) persists exact IPs only (banned_ips namespace)
cases.redis_interop/rio_behavior_usage_increme: BehaviorTracker (behavior.ts) is memory-only: initializeRedis stores the handler but no usage/return zset is ever written to Redis
cases.redis_interop/rio_behavior_return_increm: BehaviorTracker (behavior.ts) is memory-only: initializeRedis stores the handler but no usage/return zset is ever written to Redis
cases.redis_interop/rio_security_headers_csp_c: SecurityHeadersManager.cacheConfiguration (security-headers.ts) persists JSON.stringify bytes (camelCase hsts keys, no json.dumps spacing), diverging from the reference canonical JSON
cases.redis_interop/rio_security_headers_hsts_: SecurityHeadersManager.cacheConfiguration (security-headers.ts) persists JSON.stringify bytes (camelCase hsts keys, no json.dumps spacing), diverging from the reference canonical JSON
cases.redis_interop/rio_security_headers_custo: SecurityHeadersManager.cacheConfiguration (security-headers.ts) persists JSON.stringify bytes (camelCase hsts keys, no json.dumps spacing), diverging from the reference canonical JSON
cases.redis_interop/rio_ipinfo_database_cache_: IPInfoManager.initializeRedis (geoip.ts) is an empty stub: no ipinfo:database cache write and no injectable download
cases.redis_interop/rio_cloud_ranges_v2_write: CloudHandler (cloud.ts) writes the legacy cloud_ranges namespace (ranges only, no regions), not cloud_ranges_v2
cases.redis_interop/rio_cloud_ip_v2_write: no RedisCloudIpStore port: the cloud_ip_v2 namespace does not exist in the TS engine
